facts.text: Under the Calumet Commitment, students who enter as freshmen and reach senior year by their seventh semester receive their senior year tuition paid in full.

sources.title: Scholarships and Grants - Calumet College of St. Joseph
sources.quote: The Calumet Commitment Your Senior Year Tuition Paid In Full Enter Calumet College of St. Joseph as a freshman Reach senior year by the 7th semester from the start of freshman year
